trigger.description: A daemon memory write commits, then derived publication fails against an invalid index path. The successful source acknowledgement retains the memory ID, index job ID, full remember report, and indexStatus:failed. Sibling journal/outcome writes remain successful.
setup_commands: # Initialize a fresh workspace database, then place a regular file at the absent .ee/index path.
trigger.invocation: ee.daemon.write with a supported memory payload addressed to that workspace

message_contains: Do not repeat the source write
